title: Print a profile with Printf
hints: `fmt.Printf(format, args...)` replaces each verb in `format` with the next argument, in order.

Each line needs its own `
`: `fmt.Printf("Name:   %s
", name)`.
Three calls: `%s` for name, `%d` for year, `%t` for active. Count the spaces after each colon: `Name:` + 3 spaces, `Born:` + 3 spaces, `Active:` + 1 space.
